title: IceCube just won a Nobel prize. Protect astroparticle physics projects with the same potential
title_zh: IceCube刚刚获得诺贝尔奖。用同等潜力保护天体粒子物理项目
abstract: Building the Nobel-prizewinning neutrino experiment was a big risk. To continue its success, scientists — and funders — need to stay bold.
abstract_zh: 建设这项诺贝尔奖获奖的中微子实验是一项重大冒险。为了延续其成功，科学家——以及资助者——需要保持大胆。
snippet: Building the Nobel-prizewinning neutrino experiment was a big risk. To continue its success, scientists — and funders — need to stay bold.
